schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).
note: a WEGA program without a System III source, written from the disassembly; not stripped; byte-identical with the shipped cc (-O) and /lib/libc.a, the name of the object in the symbol table (cc.818.o, the PID of the cc of the original) patched by dd in src/cmd/Makefile.

main.note: the names are guessed. buf has 200 ints (the frame) of which 16 are used; the loop of the last line reuses addr as its index and tests only >= ' ' (a bug, see the quirks table); the error path of fopen is a goto to the last printf (the jump of the original goes there).
